brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: No bin part installed at level 2; bin sockets exist but not placed in final build

finish.summary: Built a three-level vertical core but stopped before adding drawers and bins per instruction to check and finish. Tower structure exists; functional storage requirements remain unmet.
